bio.text: Craig Williams, a Republican, represents District 11 in the Iowa House of Representatives; the Iowa Legislature's biography lists Williams as serving a first House term after one term in the Iowa Senate.

The biography describes Williams as an independent agriculture business consultant (a senior associate at The Context Network), a former software developer and seed business professional, and a former treasurer of the Iowa Republican State Central Committee.
It lists a B.S. in operations management and information systems from Bradley University (1984), and says Williams was born in 1963 in Rockford, Illinois, and lives in Manning.
